alex: hitting an alert for eu-north GPU pool — sustained 95% utilization, multiple provisioning failures. alertbot flagged ENI errors. @bella are you on call?

alertbot: ALERT: eu-north1-gpu-pool high-util (95%), provisioning_failures=12 in 10m, avg_start_latency=24s. Runbook: /runbooks/gpu-capacity. Recommend auto-tilt candidate: eu-west2. suggested_tilt=15%.

bella: on it. pausing the scheduled scaling tweak for this window. can we tilt 15% to eu-west2? any objections? :thinking_face:

charlie: eu-west2 at ~70% but has spare burst headroom. 15% tilt estimate ~= +$1.2k/day on our cost model. acceptable short term. :+1:

morgan: provisioning failures look like ENI rate-limit errors from cloud infra (throttled ENI attach). opening vendor ticket now. in the short term: recommend local failover + lowering batch size for long polling jobs to ease warmup. set `BATCH_MAX=8` for affected routes.

alex: good plan. also can we tweak alertbot escalation windows for eu-north during the tilt? lower from 300s -> 180s so we get faster human escalation if tilt doesn't stabilize. @bella can you push that?

bella: pushing policy change now. will also set manual cost-approval so tilt doesn't auto-scale beyond 20% without approval. deploying...

alertbot: POLICY CHANGE APPLIED by bella: {region: eu-north, escalation_window: 180s, auto_tilt_percent: 15, cost_approval: manual}. deploy_id: d-9876. note: auto-tilt will only trigger after 2 consecutive 5m windows.

charlie: tilt started at 1885000025. observing metrics: token throughput stable, median latency ok, tail latency spikes x2 for large prompts. recommend enabling fallback circuit-breaker for responses >3s to route to small-model-v2.

alex: agree. morgan please own the cloud vendor ticket and follow up in the morning handoff. i'll add a short note in the oncall-runbook and flag for next rotation. thanks everyone. :pray:
